# Fable review request: PR 1445 at 98926849dd88a014bfdb148a8d216f5d37c598ff

## What to review
Loading speed work (battle loading sliced across frames, launch prefetch of battle scene and campaign host on workers, title waits a frame at a time for the host read, first-painted-menu timing, cold-title bench step with a written save). Focus: correctness of threaded ResourceLoader use, races between the title wait, _clear, quitting and other screens, anything that could freeze or crash on a cold Windows launch, bench timers that could pass while the player sees a long wait, and clashes with main.

## Issue 1434 body (the brief)
Owner: opus
Brief: below; evidence contrib/openai/astra_council_1120/report.md items 2, 10 and W4 (PR 1432); council list items 9 and 34
Deliver to: godot/scenes/battle/battle.gd, godot/main/main.gd, godot/audio/sfx.gd as needed
Branch: opus/issue-<this number>
Base: main
Done when: a cold 24-unit battle load (s25, real hulls, PC) shows no single main-thread stretch over 500 ms after the cover appears (today 6.1 s in one call, worst single view 679 ms) and the cover shows a ships-ready count; the title buttons answer clicks while the backdrop battle builds (today 8.5 s synchronous); the SFX bus does not change when the title backdrop starts or ends at volume 0.25 and muted; the player path records Battles 1 to 3 cleanly. Ryan sees a loading screen that moves and a title that answers at once.
Reading (Board, Nov 21, LOAD10): graded on a warm profile (the player's second launch onward: shader, pipeline and bake caches on disk), with the cold first launch reported alongside on the same items; one condition on the cold pass: the loading cover stays up through the compile, no blank or stalled window (no frame of 5 s or more). The bench's RESULT line names the profile and its COVER line carries the cold condition. What this supersedes, for 1434 only: the cold-launch reading of the 500 ms limits above (stretch, cover frame, title frame) is replaced by the same limits on the warm profile plus the cold cover rule; on the cold profile those numbers are reported, not graded. Issues 1518 and 1519 keep their own limits on both profiles (Artoo on PR 1445) and ride on the same pin (LOAD11, superseding LOAD10). The title shader warm-up is a parked follow-up issue.

## Run 1 brief (current)

1. Battle load (item 2): under the cover, `board.build`, `world.build` and the `_make_view(u)` loop run before `await _warmup()` in one go (battle.gd ~498 to 637). Request the manifest resources as soon as the roster is known, poll for loaded status, yield to draw between views with a count. Keep scene attachment, overrides and FX registration on the main thread. Time load vs instantiate vs registration for one view and slice the biggest. Keep the later reinforcement/FX warm-up.
2. Title backdrop (item 10): reuse the sliced loader with a title-instance token so leaving the menu stops the build. Skip combat-only cuts, shield prep and combat FX warm-up for the showcase; cap its quality at High with its own MSAA; restore gameplay viewport settings on leave. Do not just lengthen the timer.
3. Showcase audio (W4): the backdrop battle starts its own SFX node at vol 0.8 and writes the shared bus (measured -21.42 to -5.25 dB at a 0.25 setting) after loading the whole sound bank. Give the showcase a silent path that loads no bank and never writes bus state. This is a code-path fix, not sound design.

No rules change. Refs #1408

## House audit checklist
---
name: independent-audit
description: Pre-merge adversarial audit for Voidsworn PRs and systems. Catches silent visual, audio, physics, asset-pipeline, and cross-PR regressions that unit checks and happy-path tests miss. Use before merging any Godot FX, rendering, ship import, audio, or battle-feel PR.
---

# Voidsworn Independent Audit Checklist

Run this audit on any non-trivial PR diff (especially in `godot/fx/`, `godot/render/`, `godot/audio/`, `godot/rules/`, and `tools/pc/`) **before** merging or queuing expensive GPU comparison runs. Report only concrete, line-numbered findings observed directly in the diff or `origin/main`. Never invent issues; if a check passes cleanly, skip it.

House rules apply: only Ryan rules (propose changes, never self-merge), no em dashes, no human-hour estimates, `gh api` REST only.

## The 8 Silent-Bug Traps (Check Every PR Against These)

1. **Cross-PR uniform and state collisions:** Check `git log origin/main -n 10 --oneline` and grep every touched shader uniform (`fx_power`, `fx_flick`, `fx_weather`, `fx_scorch_*`, `gate`, `melt_*`) to ensure two PRs are not driving competing systems or overwriting each other.
2. **Audio vs VFX and faction-material contradictions:** Check all 6 factions (`voidsworn`, `corsair`, `ithar`, `deathless`, `chorus`, `hegemony`). Glasswrights (`ithar`, `hit_glass`) never get orange metal fire, soot smoke, red embers, metal wear darkening (R402), matte-black `wreck_interior` soot (R416), or white cold-gas RCS jets. Chorus (`chorus`, `hit_wet`) never gets metal plate debris, soot wear (R402), hardcoded purple/magenta wound tints, matte-black `wreck_interior` soot (R416), or mechanical RCS jets. Eclipse (`deathless`) uses its own `damage_glow` / violet accents (including `CORE_RGB` inside `inside_material()`), never hardcoded brass-orange sparks, neon grids, or green core/doom glow. Damaged non-Hullbreaker engines never leak Hullbreaker black soot (`fx_ship.gd`).
3. **Guard conditions on edge states:** Always trace (a) shield-absorbed hits (`absorbed and not breaking`): an ordinary shield block is quiet per R412 rule 4 (docs/playbooks/deaths_and_hits.md, "Weapon firing and hit reactions"): no brownout, stutter, RCS spam, or marks; read that rule for the reactions it keeps (shield breaks, crits and ion hits) before calling one a finding, (b) fresh stage-0 hulls (`ensure_damage_surfaces(fx)` needed before reading `_damage_surfaces`), (c) mid-effect `death()`, `teardown()`, and Eclipse `revive()` cleanup, and (d) specialty kill causes (`acid`, `ram`, `board`, `ion`) not firing default blast beats.
4. **Parent-node UI coupling and coordinate/unit sanity:** Keep `fx_marker` and `fx_ring` flat on `ShipView` root; put hit roll, pitch, yaw, drift, shudder, and `_list` on `hull_pivot`. Check helper units (`fx.stk` arg #6 is world length, not `length / speed`), continuous lever arms (no sign flip at `y = 0`), and base-heading drift rotation.
5. **Clock desyncs (`fx.now` vs real time vs battle speed):** Visual ship motion (`bob`, `nod`, `hit_react`, `turret_step`, `door_step`) must respect `fx.now` / `hit_pause` rather than unpaused `Time.get_ticks_msec()`, with clamped slow-frame integration (issue 1467).
6. **Asset-pipeline producer vs runtime loader names and interior/breach integrity:** Verify exact filename patterns between builders (`build_assets.gd`, bakes) and loaders (`fx_fragments.gd`, ship loader), and confirm node-name walkers (`turret_*`, `*_turn`, `hp_*`, `hp_w<slot>_*`, `door_*`) have safe fallbacks or hard CI checks. On damage and ship PRs (R416, issues 1741 and 1743), verify breach cutouts pass 8-ray footprint and normal-gated overlay checks (zero off-hull portals on thin rings/fins, turret and door clearance), disabled `weapons[i].off` slots bind to their actual turrets/mounts, and V2 ship interiors carry modeled geometry plus shared trim maps verified by cutaway renders and `surface_check.py` (0 outside room pixels).
7. **Silent fallbacks and zero-op branches:** Audit every `return`, `continue`, `.get(key, default)`, and `skipped` counter for weapons silently collapsing into defaults, missing hardpoints skipping volleys, or tests bypassing the live production path.
8. **Ruling and doc landing check (R214):** Confirm working rules, look standards, and API contracts land in `docs/RULEBOOK.md`, `docs/playbooks/*.md`, or `godot/fx/API.md` with zero em dashes. Rules edits change Godot only (RULEBOOK 3.1, R405: the browser rules files are retired) and pass the Godot saved-results check.

## Output Format

Post reviews as `<Seat> (audit):` naming the commit SHA read. This layers over the outside-review evidence contract (docs/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md, RULEBOOK 2.11): every finding keeps its file:line, exact quote and OBSERVED or INFERRED label, and the review ends with `Not checked:`. Group the findings into:
1. **Blocking** (rule violations, visible regressions, or clashes with merged `main`).
2. **High / Medium** (unit mismatches, silent fallbacks, missing faction/edge handling).
3. **Ready / Verified** (1-line summary of what passed cleanly).


## Review protocol
# Review protocol for outside AI agents (Argon, Gemini, ChatGPT, others)

Outside reviews keep coming back half-read or made up. These rules are mandatory. A review that skips them gets thrown out.

## 1. Prove you read it
- Open files in raw view: `https://github.com/rcbailey12/voidsworn/raw/main/<path>`. Not the normal GitHub page (it folds long lines and loads in chunks).
- Write down the commit you reviewed (the short id shown on the repo's main page).
- For every file: total line count, and the exact text of the first 40 characters of the LAST line.
- Big files (over 1,500 lines or 60 KB): read in parts by line range and list each range you read. Never assume the rest.
- If you cannot see the end of a file, stop and say so.

## 2. Stay in scope
- Answer only the question you were given, on only the files named. No general advice ("consider adding tests").
- Max 10 findings, most important first. Fewer good findings beat many weak ones.

## 3. Evidence for every claim
- Each finding: file, line number, and an exact quote (under 20 words) copied from the file.
- Every function, variable or setting you name must appear in the file. Search for it before you write it. Do not invent names or APIs.
- Mark each finding OBSERVED (you saw it in the code) or INFERRED (your reasoning). Inferred findings need a reason.
- "Not enough info" is a good answer. Guessing is not.

## 4. Check yourself before you hand it in
- Re-open every cited line and confirm the quote matches word for word. Delete any finding whose quote does not match.
- End with "Not checked": what you did not read or could not verify.

## 5. Output
- Table: # | finding | OBSERVED/INFERRED | file:line | exact quote | why it matters | your fix | confidence (high/med/low)
- Then your one recommended next step.
- Save it as `contrib/<your-name>/reviews/<topic>.md`. Do not edit any file outside `contrib/`.

## Tips for whoever starts the review
- Gemini: uploading the files directly (it takes very long inputs) is more reliable than letting it browse.
- One system per run (battle rules, then AI, then menus...), not "the whole game".
- Paste this file's rules into the prompt, or tell the agent: "Follow docs/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md exactly."
- Claude checks every claim against the code before merging anything (see docs/ship_pipeline/AUDIT_SYNTHESIS.md).

+# Issue 1434 LOAD10 (with issues 1518 and 1519, Board Nov 21): one pinned checkout, graded on a WARM profile, the cold
+# first launch reported alongside on the same items.
+#   1. load bench, cold: godot/bench/load_1434.gd on a fresh Godot profile inside this attempt folder (no shader cache,
+#      no pipeline cache, no world bakes on disk). Reported, plus its COVER line: the loading cover up on every frame
+#      to play and no frame of 5 s or more (the Board's one condition on the cold pass).

+# Writes <Out>\load10_result.txt with one line per result (1434 load; 1518, 1519 and clean close, cold and warm) and the
+# gate line "[load10] RESULT PASS" only when every one passes. Nothing outside <Out> is written; every profile lives under <Out>.
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Godot, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Project, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Out)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Out | Out-Null
+$res = Join-Path $Out 'load10_result.txt'
+"LOAD10, project $Project, $(Get-Date -Format s)" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $res -Encoding Ascii
+function Say($s) { Write-Output $s; Add-Content -LiteralPath $res -Value $s -Encoding Ascii }
+$keepApp = $env:APPDATA; $keepLocal = $env:LOCALAPPDATA
+
+function Kill-Tree($p) {
+  try { & taskkill.exe /T /F /PID $p.Id 2>&1 | Out-Null } catch {}
+}
+
+function Start-Game($profile, $argList, $log, $err) {
+  $env:APPDATA = $profile; $env:LOCALAPPDATA = $profile
+  try {
+    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $Godot -ArgumentList $argList -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError $err
+    $null = $p.Handle   # keeps ExitCode readable after exit (PowerShell 5.1)
+  } finally { $env:APPDATA = $keepApp; $env:LOCALAPPDATA = $keepLocal }
+  return $p
+}
+
+# Artoo on PR 1445: read back whether the warm launch really reuses the caches. Godot's shader cache
+# (user://shader_cache) and the Vulkan pipeline cache (user://vulkan) are counted before and after each launch on the
+# shared profile: a warm launch that reuses them adds few or no files, and the pipeline cache file is the same size.
+function Get-CacheStat($profile) {
+  $ud = Join-Path $profile 'Godot\app_userdata\Voidsworn'
+  $o = [ordered]@{}
+  foreach ($d in @('shader_cache', 'vulkan', 'world_bakes')) {
+    $p = Join-Path $ud $d
+    $files = @(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { @() })
+    $o[$d] = @{n = $files.Count; mb = [math]::Round((($files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB, 1)}
+  }
+  return $o
+}
+function Say-Cache($label, $before, $after) {
+  $bits = foreach ($k in $after.Keys) { "$k $($before[$k].n) -> $($after[$k].n) files ($($before[$k].mb) -> $($after[$k].mb) MB)" }
+  Say "cache readback, $label`: $($bits -join '; ')"
+}
+
+# ---- 1 and 2: the load bench, cold then warm, on one profile
+$warmProfile = Join-Path $Out 'profile_warm'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $warmProfile | Out-Null
+$bench = @{}
+foreach ($pass in @('cold', 'warm')) {
+  $d = Join-Path $Out "load_$pass"
+  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null
+  $argList = @('--path', "`"$Project`"", '--fullscreen', '--script', 'res://bench/load_1434.gd', '--', '--out', "`"$d`"", '--pass', $pass)
+  $c0 = Get-CacheStat $warmProfile
+  $p = Start-Game $warmProfile $argList (Join-Path $d 'log.txt') (Join-Path $d 'log_err.txt')
+  if (-not $p.WaitForExit(1500 * 1000)) { Kill-Tree $p; Say "load $pass`: FAIL: still running after 1500 s, stopped" }
+  Say-Cache "load $pass" $c0 (Get-CacheStat $warmProfile)
+  $txt = Join-Path $d 'load_result.txt'
+  $r = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $txt) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $txt -Raw } else { '' }
+  $bench[$pass] = @{
+    result = [regex]::Match($r, '\[load1434\] RESULT [^\r\n]*').Value
+    cover = [regex]::Match($r, '\[load1434\] COVER [^\r\n]*').Value
+    pass = $r -match '\[load1434\] RESULT PASS'
+    cover_pass = $r -match '\[load1434\] COVER PASS'
+    title = [regex]::Match($r, '\[load1434\] title (PASS|FAIL)[^\r\n]*').Value
+    title_pass = $r -match '\[load1434\] title PASS'
+    title_split = [regex]::Match($r, '\[load1434\] title worst frames split: [^\r\n]*').Value

+    Say "load $pass`: $($bench[$pass].title)"; Say "load $pass`: $($bench[$pass].title_split)"
+  }

+}
+
+# ---- 3: the close cases (close1435_timing5.ps1's method), cold set then warm set
+Add-Type -Namespace V1434L -Name User32 -MemberDefinition @'
+[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern System.IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
+[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsIconic(System.IntPtr hWnd);
+[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr hWnd);
+[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetClassName(System.IntPtr hWnd, System.Text.StringBuilder buf, int max);
+[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool PostMessage(System.IntPtr hWnd, uint msg, System.IntPtr wParam, System.IntPtr lParam);
+'@
+function Get-WindowClass($h) { $b = New-Object Text.StringBuilder 256; [void][V1434L.User32]::GetClassName($h, $b, 256); $b.ToString() }
+function Find-Game($p, $seconds) {
+  $t = Get-Date
+  while (((Get-Date) - $t).TotalSeconds -lt $seconds) {
+    $cands = @($p)
+    try { $cands += @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ParentProcessId=$($p.Id)" | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(Godot|Voidsworn)' } | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }) } catch {}
+    foreach ($q in $cands) {
+      if (-not $q) { continue }
+      $q.Refresh()
+      if ($q.HasExited -or $q.MainWindowHandle -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { continue }
+      $cls = Get-WindowClass $q.MainWindowHandle
+      if ($cls -in @('ConsoleWindowClass', 'CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS', 'PseudoConsoleWindow')) { continue }
+      $null = $q.Handle
+      return @{proc = $q; cls = $cls}
+    }
+    if ($p.HasExited) { return $null }

+}
+$cases = @(
+  @{name = 'x_load_4s'; how = 'x'; wait = 4},
+  @{name = 'altf4_load_5s'; how = 'altf4'; wait = 5; hide = 500},

+)

+$rows = @()

+    $log = Join-Path $dir 'game.log'; $err = Join-Path $dir 'game_err.log'; $flog = Join-Path $dir 'godot_file.log'
+    $argList = @('--path', "`"$Project`"", '--windowed', '--resolution', '1920x1080', '--log-file', "`"$flog`"", '--', '--battle', '--quit-after', '240')

+          else { $row.skip = 'Alt-F4 UNVERIFIED: the system close could not be posted, closed with the title bar close'; [void]$g.CloseMainWindow() }
+        }
+        else { $row.skip = 'Alt-F4 UNVERIFIED: no game window handle, closed with the title bar close'; $sw.Restart(); [void]$g.CloseMainWindow() }
+      }
+      $hwnd = $g.MainWindowHandle

+        $row.exit_code = $g.ExitCode
+        $per = @($flog, $log) | ForEach-Object { $t1 = Get-Content -LiteralPath $_ -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($t1) { ([regex]::Matches($t1, '\[main\] quit \(')).Count } else { 0 } }

+        $row.quit_lines = ($per | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
+        $mt = [regex]::Match($text, 'battle to title: leave frame ([0-9.]+) ms, first title frame ([0-9.]+) ms')

+        if ($mw.Success) { $row.title_worst_first_second_ms = [double]$mw.Groups[1].Value }

index 000000000..1e056f97b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/contrib/opus/tools/ps1_parse_tests.js
@@ -0,0 +1,106 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// Every tracked PowerShell script must parse (Board, Nov 21, issue 1530): LOAD11 (issue 1434) reached the PC with one
+// ")" too many in contrib/opus/pc/1434/load1434_runs.ps1 and failed after a 30 minute run without its bench ever
+// starting. A bat that calls a script that does not parse should fail CI instead.
+// Uses PowerShell's own parser ([System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile) through pwsh, which the
+// GitHub ubuntu runner has. A broken fixture is parsed first, so a parser that reports nothing cannot pass the check.
+// Without pwsh: FAIL on GitHub Actions, a plain "not run" line elsewhere (a cloud or Linux checkout without pwsh).
+'use strict';
+const fs = require('fs');
+const os = require('os');
+const path = require('path');
+const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');
+
+const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
+
+function trackedScripts() {
+  const r = spawnSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z', '--', '*.ps1'], { cwd: ROOT, encoding: 'utf8' });
+  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('git ls-files failed: ' + (r.stderr || '').trim());
+  return r.stdout.split('\0').filter(f => f && !f.startsWith('docs/archive/')).sort();
+}
+
+function havePwsh() {
+  const r = spawnSync('pwsh', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
+  return r.status === 0 ? r.stdout.trim() : '';
+}
+
+const PARSER = `param([string]$List)
+$n = 0
+foreach ($f in Get-Content -LiteralPath $List) {
+  if (-not $f) { continue }
+  $n++
+  $tokens = $null; $errors = $null
+  [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($f, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors)
+  foreach ($e in $errors) { "PARSE|$f|$($e.Extent.StartLineNumber)|$($e.Extent.StartColumnNumber)|$($e.Message)" }
+}
+"FILES|$n"
+`;
+
+function parse(files) {
+  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ps1parse-'));
+  try {
+    const script = path.join(dir, 'parse.ps1');
+    const list = path.join(dir, 'list.txt');
+    fs.writeFileSync(script, PARSER);
+    fs.writeFileSync(list, files.join('\n') + '\n');
+    const r = spawnSync('pwsh', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-File', script, '-List', list], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 64 << 20 });
+    if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('pwsh exited ' + r.status + ': ' + (r.stderr || '').trim().slice(0, 400));
+    const out = r.stdout.split(/\r?\n/);
+    const counted = out.find(l => l.startsWith('FILES|'));
+    const errors = out.filter(l => l.startsWith('PARSE|')).map(l => {
+      const [, file, line, col, ...msg] = l.split('|');
+      return { file, line: +line, col: +col, msg: msg.join('|') };
+    });
+    return { files: counted ? +counted.split('|')[1] : -1, errors };
+  } finally {
+    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+  }
+}
+
+function main() {
+  const version = havePwsh();
+  if (!version) {
+    if (process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true') {
+      console.log('FAIL: pwsh is not on this runner, so no PowerShell script was parsed');
+      process.exit(1);
+    }
+    console.log('ps1_parse_tests: not run here (no pwsh on this machine); GitHub CI parses every tracked .ps1');
+    return;
+  }
+  // the fixture: the LOAD11 mistake, one ")" too many after a $( ) inside a -f argument list
+  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ps1fix-'));
+  const bad = path.join(dir, 'broken.ps1');
+  fs.writeFileSync(bad, 'function Say($s) { $s }\nSay ("{0}" -f $(if ($true) { "a" } else { \'\' })))\n');
+  const good = path.join(dir, 'fine.ps1');
+  fs.writeFileSync(good, 'function Say($s) { $s }\nSay ("{0}" -f $(if ($true) { "a" } else { \'\' }))\n');
+  let fx;
+  try { fx = parse([bad, good]); } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
+  const badCaught = fx.errors.some(e => e.file === bad);
+  const goodClean = !fx.errors.some(e => e.file === good);
+  if (!badCaught || !goodClean) {
+    console.log('FAIL: the parser fixture went wrong (broken script caught: ' + badCaught + ', clean script clean: ' + goodClean + ')');
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+  const files = trackedScripts().map(f => path.join(ROOT, f));
+  const r = parse(files);
+  if (r.files !== files.length) {
+    console.log('FAIL: pwsh parsed ' + r.files + ' of ' + files.length + ' scripts');
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+  const byFile = new Map();
+  for (const e of r.errors) {
+    const rel = path.relative(ROOT, e.file).split(path.sep).join('/');
+    if (!byFile.has(rel)) byFile.set(rel, []);
+    byFile.get(rel).push(e);
+  }
+  if (byFile.size) {
+    for (const [f, es] of byFile) {
+      console.log('  ' + f + ': ' + es.slice(0, 3).map(e => 'line ' + e.line + ' char ' + e.col + ': ' + e.msg).join('; ') + (es.length > 3 ? ' (+' + (es.length - 3) + ' more)' : ''));
+    }
+    console.log('FAIL: ' + byFile.size + ' of ' + files.length + ' PowerShell scripts do not parse (pwsh ' + version + ')');
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+  console.log('PASS: all ' + files.length + ' tracked PowerShell scripts parse (pwsh ' + version + ', broken fixture caught)');
+}
+
+main();

+extends SceneTree
+# Issue 1434 PC proof: the battle's ships are built a few per frame under the loading cover, and the title backdrop
+# builds behind a menu that keeps answering, without touching the sound volume.
+# Cases, in this order, in one windowed process on the real renderer and the real hulls:
+#   s25        the 24-unit scenario, first so its hull files load cold
+#   title      main.gd's title with its backdrop at sound volume 0.25: worst frame while it builds, and the shared sfx bus
+#              read every frame from before the backdrop starts until it is freed (must not move)
+#   leave      a second cold title, New run clicked while its backdrop builds
+#   b1, b2, b3 three default sector 1 fights (start_default, seeds 101, 202, 303), the shape of Battles 1 to 3
+#   s25r       the 24-ship battle again in the same process, every shader and pipeline it uses already made (reported
+#              only, issue 1434 LOAD19: if its 5 s hull-prep draw comes back, first-use compiling is not the cause)
+#   b2r        Battle 2 again, its world bakes run again with every shader warm (reported only, see _b2_again)
+# Per battle: the longest main-thread stretch of the ship build (battle.gd load_stats: one ship's setup or its effects
+# registration at most), the worst single ship's setup and registration, and the worst frame from the cover to play,
+# with the load phase of the five worst frames and the time spent in each phase.
+# Graded separately (Artoo on PR 1445), every one must hold for PASS:
+#   slice   the longest ship build stretch under 500 ms
+#   ready   the battle reached play (warming cleared) / the backdrop reached showcase_ready before its time limit
+#   cover   the worst frame from the cover to play under 500 ms (it includes the existing shader warm-up)
+#   frame   the title's longest wall-clock frame from the backdrop's start to showcase_ready under 500 ms
+#   click   the title's Settings link, clicked by a real mouse press and release while the backdrop is still building,
+#           opens its drawer within 500 ms
+#   bus     the title's shared sfx bus never moved (sound on at 0.25 here; the muted case and 0.25 both run in CI in
+#           main/test/showcase_quiet_check.gd)
+#   leave   New run clicked (real mouse) while the title backdrop has a load or kit instance pending: that backdrop's exit
+#           under 100 ms on the main thread, and the campaign painted; no try caught pending is INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS
+# Run: godot --path godot [--fullscreen] --script res://bench/load_1434.gd -- --out <folder>
+const BattleScene = preload("res://scenes/battle/battle.tscn")
+const MainScript = preload("res://main/main.gd")
+const BAKER = preload("res://world/world_bake.gd")
+const HULL = preload("res://fx/fx_hull.gd")
+const SKEEP = preload("res://render/shader_keep.gd")
+
+
+func _stage_name(w: int) -> String:
+	return ["idle", "disk check", "compute", "png save", "prune", "mips"][w] if w >= 0 and w < 6 else str(w)
+const LIMIT_MS := 500
+var out_dir := ""
+var lines: Array = []
+var pass_all := true
+var finished: Array = []   # each case adds its name as its last step, so a case cut short by a script error fails the run
+var cases := PackedStringArray(["s25", "title", "leave", "b1", "b2", "b3", "b2r", "s25r"])
+# Board, Nov 21 (LOAD10): graded on a warm profile (the player's second launch onward: Godot's shader and pipeline caches
+# and the world bakes already on disk), with the cold first launch reported alongside on the same items. --pass names
+# which this run is; the runner (load1434_runs.ps1) starts the bench twice on one profile, cold then warm.
+var pass_name := "one"
+# The cold condition (Board): the first launch must still show the loading cover while shaders compile, never a blank
+# or stalled window. Every frame from the cover to play must have the cover up, and no frame may reach 5 s (Windows
+# marks a window that has not answered for 5 s as not responding).
+const STALL_MS := 5000
+var cover_ok_all := true
+var cover_notes: Array = []
+
+
+# issue 1434 (Board on LOAD13): each frame's wall time split into the renderer's draw (frame_pre_draw to frame_post_draw)
+# and everything before it on the main thread (scripts, physics, waits), plus the effects work it named (fx.prof)
+var _pre_us := 0
+var _draw_us := 0
+
+
+# the node whose hull-prep step a frame row names: read at frame_pre_draw, the step the draw that follows belongs to
+# (Artoo on PR 1445: a label read after the frame could already name the next step)
+var _watch: Node = null
+var _draw_step := ""
+
+
+var _draw_ins := {}   # hull-prep installs before the draws of this row
+# issue 1434 (LOAD20: 83 pipelines in one hull-prep draw, no install named): the meshes added to the tree before the
+# draws of this row, by name without its digits and its parent's, and the texture and buffer memory at each row
+var _nodes_now := {}
+var _draw_nodes := {}
+var _mem_last := -1.0
+var _digits := RegEx.create_from_string("[0-9@]+")
+
+
+func _on_node_added(n: Node) -> void:
+	if n is GeometryInstance3D:
+		var p := n.get_parent()
+		var g := p.get_parent() if p != null else null
+		# LOAD23 (cold s25: 7 meshes under an unnamed node in the cuts frame, 83 pipelines): the grandparent and the script
+		# line that added the mesh (a debug build's stack), so the row names who adds it
+		var key := "%s<%s<%s" % [_digits.sub(str(n.name), "", true), _digits.sub(str(p.name), "", true) if p != null else "-", _digits.sub(str(g.name), "", true) if g != null else "-"]
+		for fr in get_stack():
+			var src := str(fr.get("source", ""))
+			if src != "" and not src.ends_with("load_1434.gd"):
+				key += " @%s:%d" % [src.get_file(), int(fr.get("line", 0))]
+				break
+		_nodes_now[key] = int(_nodes_now.get(key, 0)) + 1
+
+
+func _nodes_take() -> String:
+	var keys := _draw_nodes.keys()
+	if keys.is_empty():
+		return "-"
+	var total := 0
+	for k in keys: total += int(_draw_nodes[k])
+	keys.sort_custom(func(x, y): return int(_draw_nodes[x]) > int(_draw_nodes[y]))
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for k in keys.slice(0, 5): out.append("%s x%d" % [str(k), int(_draw_nodes[k])])
+	_draw_nodes = {}
+	return "%d: %s" % [total, ", ".join(out)]
+
+
+func _mem_take() -> String:
+	var m := (Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TEXTURE_MEM_USED) + Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_BUFFER_MEM_USED)) / 1048576.0
+	var d := m - _mem_last if _mem_last >= 0.0 else 0.0
+	_mem_last = m
+	return "%+.0f MB" % d
+var _draw_made: Array = []   # new shaders before the draws of this row
+var _draw_pipes := {}   # pipelines inside the draws of this row, by source
+var _pipe_at_pre := {}
+
+
+func _on_pre_draw() -> void:
+	_pre_us = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_pipe_at_pre = _pipe_counts()
+	if _watch != null and is_instance_valid(_watch):
+		var fx = _watch.get("gfx")
+		if fx != null and is_instance_valid(fx) and str(fx.get("prep_step")) != "" and fx.get("prep_step") != null:
+			var st := str(fx.get("prep_step"))
+			if not _draw_step.contains(st):
+				_draw_step = st if _draw_step == "" else _draw_step + " + " + st
+		# Artoo on PR 1445 (LOAD18): the installs and new shaders made before this draw, taken here so a later
+		# coroutine step cannot add to them before the row is written
+		if fx != null and is_instance_valid(fx) and fx.has_method("installs_take"):
+			var d: Dictionary = fx.installs_take()
+			for k in d: _draw_ins[k] = int(_draw_ins.get(k, 0)) + int(d[k])
+	_draw_made.append_array(SKEEP.made)
+	SKEEP.made.clear()
+	for k in _nodes_now: _draw_nodes[k] = int(_draw_nodes.get(k, 0)) + int(_nodes_now[k])
+	_nodes_now = {}
+
+
+func _on_post_draw() -> void:
+	if _pre_us > 0:
+		_draw_us += Time.get_ticks_usec() - _pre_us
+		# the pipelines counted from this draw's start to its end, by source
+		var now := _pipe_counts()
+		for k in now: _draw_pipes[k] = int(_draw_pipes.get(k, 0)) + int(now[k]) - int(_pipe_at_pre.get(k, now[k]))
+	_pre_us = 0
+
+
+func _take_draw() -> float:
+	var d := _draw_us / 1000.0
+	_draw_us = 0
+	return d
+
+
+# the three biggest named effects costs since the last frame, "prep:shield 210 ms, ..." ("-" when none)
+func _fx_work(node) -> String:
+	if node == null or not is_instance_valid(node):
+		return "-"
+	var fx = node.get("gfx")
+	if fx == null or not is_instance_valid(fx) or not fx.has_method("prof_take"):
+		return "-"
+	var step := _draw_step
+	_draw_step = ""
+	var p: Dictionary = fx.prof_take()
+	var keys := p.keys()
+	keys.sort_custom(func(x, y): return int(p[x]) > int(p[y]))
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for k in keys.slice(0, 3):
+		if int(p[k]) >= 1000:
+			out.append("%s %d ms" % [str(k), int(p[k]) / 1000])
+	var said := ", ".join(out) if not out.is_empty() else "-"
+	# issue 1434 (LOAD17): what hull prep installed before this row's draws (taken at frame_pre_draw)
+	var ins := PackedStringArray()
+	for k in _draw_ins: ins.append("%s %d" % [str(k), int(_draw_ins[k])])
+	_draw_ins = {}
+	return said + (" (hull prep step at the draw: %s)" % step if step != "" else "") + (", installed before the draw: " + ", ".join(ins) if not ins.is_empty() else "")
+
+
+# Performance.TIME_PROCESS read after a frame's await is the step before it (the battle's coroutine runs ahead of the
+# bench in the same signal), so each row takes the process time read on the row after it
+static func _shift_process(fs: Array) -> void:
+	for i in fs.size():
+		fs[i][6] = fs[i + 1][6] if i + 1 < fs.size() else -1.0
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	HULL.late_stacks = true
+	SKEEP.watch = true
+	RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw.connect(_on_pre_draw)
+	RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(_on_post_draw)
+	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
+	var a := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
+	var i := a.find("--out")
+	if i >= 0 and i + 1 < a.size():
+		out_dir = a[i + 1]
+	var pn := a.find("--pass")
+	if pn >= 0 and pn + 1 < a.size():
+		pass_name = a[pn + 1]
+	var c := a.find("--cases")   # a subset for a quick trial, e.g. --cases leave,b1 (the PC job runs them all)
+	if c >= 0 and c + 1 < a.size():
+		cases = a[c + 1].split(",")
+	_run.call_deferred()
+
+
+func _say(s: String) -> void:
+	print(s)
+	lines.append(s)
+
+
+# pipelines compiled so far (Godot 4.7 Forward+ monitors; 0 where the renderer has none)
+func _pipes() -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for m in ["PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_CANVAS", "PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_MESH", "PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_SURFACE", "PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_DRAW", "PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_SPECIALIZATION"]:
+		if ClassDB.class_has_integer_constant("Performance", m):
+			n += int(Performance.get_monitor(ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant("Performance", m)))
+	return n
+
+
+# issue 1434 (Astra on LOAD17, issue 1573: is the 83-pipeline draw blocking pipeline creation?): the count by source since
+# the last call, "draw 80, surface 3" ("-" when none). Godot counts a pipeline built at draw time under "draw"; "surface"
+# and "mesh" ones are made ahead of the draw, "specialization" ones in the background
+const PIPE_SOURCES := ["CANVAS", "MESH", "SURFACE", "DRAW", "SPECIALIZATION"]
+
+
+func _pipe_counts() -> Dictionary:
+	var d := {}
+	for src in PIPE_SOURCES:
+		var m: String = "PIPELINE_COMPILATIONS_" + src
+		if ClassDB.class_has_integer_constant("Performance", m):
+			d[src] = int(Performance.get_monitor(ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant("Performance", m)))
+	return d
+
+
+# the pipelines counted inside this row's draws by source, "draw 80, surface 3" ("-" when none). A count, not a time:
+# how long creation took needs a trace (Artoo on PR 1445)
+func _pipes_by() -> String:
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for src in PIPE_SOURCES:
+		if int(_draw_pipes.get(src, 0)) > 0: out.append("%s %d" % [src.to_lower(), int(_draw_pipes[src])])
+	_draw_pipes = {}
+	return ", ".join(out) if not out.is_empty() else "-"
+
+
+# the new shaders made before this row's draws (taken at frame_pre_draw)
+func _made_take() -> String:
+	var n := _draw_made.size()
+	if n == 0:
+		return "-"
+	var said := ", ".join(PackedStringArray(_draw_made.slice(0, 6))) + (" and %d more" % (n - 6) if n > 6 else "")
+	_draw_made = []
+	return "%d: %s" % [n, said]
+
+
+# one line per recorded frame: where its wall-clock time went
+func _split(fs: Array) -> PackedStringArray:
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for f in fs:
+		out.append("%d ms %s (began at %d ms): draw %.0f ms, before the draw %.0f ms (process step %.0f ms), render cpu %.0f ms, gpu %.0f ms, %d pipelines compiled, %d world bakes pending" % [
+			f[0], f[1], f[7], f[9], maxf(0.0, float(f[0]) - float(f[9])), f[6], f[2], f[3], f[4], f[5]] + (" (inside the draw by source: %s)" % f[11]) + (", bake worker %s" % f[8]) + (", effects work %s" % f[10]) + (", new shaders %s" % f[12]) + (", meshes added %s, texture and buffer memory %s" % [f[13], f[14]]))
+	return out
+
+
+func _bus() -> String:
+	var i := AudioServer.get_bus_index("sfx")
+	return "%.2f dB%s" % [AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(i), " muted" if AudioServer.is_bus_mute(i) else ""] if i >= 0 else "none"
+
+
+func _battle(tag: String, args: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var b = BattleScene.instantiate()
+	for k in args:
+		b.args[k] = args[k]
+	b.args["quality"] = "max"
+	b.bot = true   # no opening beat or story voice; the bot's first turn starts only after the load
+	b.tips_off = true
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	root.add_child(b)
+	_watch = b
+	_draw_step = ""
+	var ready_ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000
+	var worst := 0
+	# [ms, phase before -> phase after, render cpu ms, gpu ms, pipelines compiled, world bakes pending] per frame under
+	# the cover (LOAD5: the long "world" frames were not script time the bench could name; this splits them)
+	var frames: Array = []
+	_take_draw()
+	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var w0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var vp_rid := root.get_viewport_rid()
+	RenderingServer.viewport_set_measure_render_time(vp_rid, true)
+	var pipes0 := _pipes()
+	_pipes_by()
+	SKEEP.made.clear()
+	_draw_made = []
+	_draw_ins = {}
+	_nodes_now = {}
+	_draw_nodes = {}
+	_mem_take()
+	var gaps := 0
+	var stalls := 0
+	while (b.warming or b.load_stats.is_empty()) and Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0 < 240000:
+		var ph0: String = b.load_phase
+		var ws0: int = BAKER.work_stage
+		await process_frame
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		worst = maxi(worst, now - last)
+		if b.warming:
+			var cv = b.hud.load_cover if b.hud != null else null
+			if cv == null or not is_instance_valid(cv) or not (cv as CanvasItem).is_visible_in_tree():
+				gaps += 1
+		if (now - last) / 1000 >= STALL_MS:
+			stalls += 1
+		var pipes := _pipes()
+		var bakes: int = int(b.world.pending_bakes) if b.world != null and is_instance_valid(b.world) else -1
+		frames.append([(now - last) / 1000, ph0 if ph0 == b.load_phase else "%s->%s" % [ph0, b.load_phase],
+			RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_cpu(vp_rid) + RenderingServer.get_frame_setup_time_cpu(),
+			RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_gpu(vp_rid), pipes - pipes0, bakes,
+			Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0, last / 1000, _stage_name(ws0) + " -> " + _stage_name(BAKER.work_stage),
+			_take_draw(), _fx_work(b), _pipes_by(), _made_take(), _nodes_take(), _mem_take()])
+		pipes0 = pipes
+		last = now
+	_shift_process(frames)
+	if OS.has_environment("VS_LOAD_ALL_ROWS"):   # a cloud trial: every row from the hull prep on, in order
+		var from := -1
+		for i in frames.size():
+			if from < 0 and str(frames[i][1]).contains("prepare_hulls"): from = i
+		if from >= 0:
+			for r in _split(frames.slice(from)): print("[load1434] %s row: %s" % [tag, r])
+	frames.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x[0] > y[0])
+	var top := PackedStringArray()
+	for f in frames.slice(0, 5):
+		top.append("%d ms %s" % [f[0], f[1]])
+	var split := _split(frames.slice(0, 5))
+	var per := {}
+	for f in frames:
+		per[f[1]] = int(per.get(f[1], 0)) + int(f[0])
+	var st: Dictionary = b.load_stats
+	var ready: bool = not b.warming
+	if st.is_empty():
+		pass_all = false
+		_say("[load1434] %s FAIL: no sliced build recorded (warming %s after %d ms)" % [tag, b.warming, Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0])
+	else:
+		var slice_ok: bool = int(st["worst_stretch"]) / 1000 < LIMIT_MS
+		var cover_ok: bool = worst / 1000 < LIMIT_MS
+		var ok: bool = slice_ok and ready and cover_ok
+		pass_all = pass_all and ok
+		_say("[load1434] %s %s (slice %s, ready %s, cover %s)" % [tag, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "PASS" if slice_ok else "FAIL",
+			"PASS" if ready else "FAIL (timed out still warming)", "PASS" if cover_ok else "FAIL"])
+		_say("[load1434] %s: %d ships in %d ms over %d frames; longest build stretch %d ms; worst ship setup %d ms (%s), worst effects registration %d ms; waiting on hull files %d ms; scene ready %d ms; worst frame cover to play %d ms; to play %d ms" % [
+			tag, st["ships"], st["ms"], st["frames"], int(st["worst_stretch"]) / 1000,
+			int(st["worst_setup"]) / 1000, st["worst_code"], int(st["worst_fx"]) / 1000, int(st["wait"]) / 1000, ready_ms,
+			worst / 1000, Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0])
+	_say("[load1434] %s cover frames: worst %s; time by phase %s" % [tag, ", ".join(top), str(per)])
+	_cover_note(tag, gaps, stalls, worst / 1000)
+	_say("[load1434] %s worst cover frames split: %s" % [tag, "; ".join(split)])
+	if not st.is_empty():
+		_say("[load1434] %s worst ship %s setup stages (us) %s; worst effects registration %s parts (us) %s; worst hull geometry %d ms (%s)" % [tag, st.get("worst_code", ""),
+			str(st.get("worst_stages", {})), st.get("worst_fx_code", ""), str(st.get("worst_fx_parts", {})),
+			int(st.get("worst_geo", 0)) / 1000, str(st.get("worst_geo_code", "-"))])
+		_say("[load1434] %s start to board parts (us) %s" % [tag, str(b.begin_us)])
+	b.queue_free()
+	for i in 30:
+		await process_frame
+	finished.append(tag)
+
+
+func _cover_note(tag: String, gaps: int, stalls: int, worst_ms: int) -> void:
+	var ok := gaps == 0 and stalls == 0
+	cover_ok_all = cover_ok_all and ok
+	cover_notes.append("%s %s" % [tag, "ok" if ok else "FAIL"])
+	_say("[load1434] %s cover check %s: %d frames without the cover before play, %d frames of %d s or more (worst %d ms)" % [
+		tag, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", gaps, stalls, STALL_MS / 1000, worst_ms])
+
+
+func _title() -> void:
+	var m = MainScript.new()
+	var tw := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	root.add_child(m)
+	# issue 1518 (Artoo on PR 1445, 6784b6b1): the title waits a frame at a time for the launch's campaign host read, so
+	# the time from the new Main to its first painted menu is its own line, and no menu in 20 s fails the title plainly
+	while (m.title == null or not is_instance_valid(m.title)) and Time.get_ticks_msec() - tw < 20000:
+		await process_frame
+	if m.title == null or not is_instance_valid(m.title):
+		pass_all = false
+		_say("[load1434] title FAIL (no menu painted 20 s after the new Main)")
+		m.queue_free()
+		for i in 10:
+			await process_frame
+		finished.append("title")
+		return
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	_say("[load1434] title launch to first painted menu: %d ms (first button: %s)" % [Time.get_ticks_msec() - tw, str(m.title.get("first_label"))])
+	for i in 5:
+		await process_frame
+	m.settings["sound"] = true
+	m.settings["volume"] = 0.25
+	m._settings_to_ui_sound()
+	await process_frame
+	var before := _bus()
+	var moved: Array = []
+	var worst := 0
+	var frames: Array = []   # as _battle: [ms, phase, render cpu ms, gpu ms, pipelines compiled, world bakes pending]
+	var vp_rid := root.get_viewport_rid()
+	RenderingServer.viewport_set_measure_render_time(vp_rid, true)
+	var pipes0 := _pipes()
+	_pipes_by()
+	SKEEP.made.clear()
+	_draw_made = []
+	_draw_ins = {}
+	_nodes_now = {}
+	_draw_nodes = {}
+	_mem_take()
+	_take_draw()
+	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var w0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var click_ms := -1        # -1: never clicked while building; -2: clicked, drawer never opened
+	var click_t := -1
+	var begin_seen := {}
+	var link: Button = _find_button(m.title, "Settings")
+	while (m.showcase == null or not is_instance_valid(m.showcase) or not m.showcase.showcase_ready) and Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0 < 240000:
+		if click_t < 0 and link != null and m.showcase != null and is_instance_valid(m.showcase) and m.showcase.api != null and m.showcase.load_stats.is_empty():
+			# the backdrop has its fleet and is building ships now: click the menu like a player
+			click_t = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+			_click(link.get_global_rect().get_center())
+		var sc0 = m.showcase
+		_watch = sc0
+		var ph0: String = sc0.load_phase if sc0 != null and is_instance_valid(sc0) else "none"
+		var ws0: int = BAKER.work_stage
+		await process_frame
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		worst = maxi(worst, now - last)
+		var sc1 = m.showcase
+		if sc1 != null and is_instance_valid(sc1) and not (sc1.begin_us as Dictionary).is_empty():
+			begin_seen = (sc1.begin_us as Dictionary).duplicate()   # LOAD29: the backdrop may be gone by the report
+		var ph1: String = sc1.load_phase if sc1 != null and is_instance_valid(sc1) else "none"
+		var pipes := _pipes()
+		var bakes: int = int(sc1.world.pending_bakes) if sc1 != null and is_instance_valid(sc1) and sc1.world != null and is_instance_valid(sc1.world) else -1
+		frames.append([(now - last) / 1000, ph0 if ph0 == ph1 else "%s->%s" % [ph0, ph1],
+			RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_cpu(vp_rid) + RenderingServer.get_frame_setup_time_cpu(),
+			RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_gpu(vp_rid), pipes - pipes0, bakes,
+			Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0, last / 1000, _stage_name(ws0) + " -> " + _stage_name(BAKER.work_stage),
+			_take_draw(), _fx_work(sc1), _pipes_by(), _made_take(), _nodes_take(), _mem_take()])
+		pipes0 = pipes
+		last = now
+		if _bus() != before: moved.append(_bus())
+		if click_t >= 0 and click_ms == -1 and m.title.settings_panel != null:
+			click_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec() - click_t
+	if click_t >= 0 and click_ms == -1:
+		click_ms = -2
+	var sc = m.showcase
+	var ready: bool = sc != null and is_instance_valid(sc) and sc.showcase_ready
+	var st: Dictionary = sc.load_stats if sc != null and is_instance_valid(sc) else {}
+	for i in 60:
+		await process_frame
+		if _bus() != before: moved.append(_bus())
+	if m.title != null and m.title.settings_panel != null:
+		m.title._close_settings()
+	m._clear()   # leaving the title: stop_build, then free
+	for i in 30:
+		await process_frame
+		if _bus() != before: moved.append(_bus())
+	var slice_ok: bool = not st.is_empty() and int(st["worst_stretch"]) / 1000 < LIMIT_MS
+	var click_ok: bool = click_ms >= 0 and click_ms < LIMIT_MS
+	# Artoo on PR 1445: a quick click does not prove the menu never froze (LOAD5: click 16 ms, one frame 7.9 s), so the
+	# longest wall-clock frame from the backdrop's start to showcase_ready is graded too, with its renderer split
+	var frame_ok: bool = worst / 1000 < LIMIT_MS
+	var ok: bool = slice_ok and ready and click_ok and frame_ok and moved.is_empty()
+	pass_all = pass_all and ok
+	_say("[load1434] title %s (slice %s, ready %s, click %s, frame %s, bus %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "PASS" if slice_ok else "FAIL",
+		"PASS" if ready else "FAIL (timed out)", ("PASS (%d ms)" % click_ms) if click_ok else ("FAIL (%s)" % ("no click while building" if click_ms == -1 else "drawer never opened" if click_ms == -2 else "%d ms" % click_ms)),
+		("PASS (%d ms)" % (worst / 1000)) if frame_ok else ("FAIL (%d ms)" % (worst / 1000)), "PASS" if moved.is_empty() else "FAIL"])
+	var stalls := 0
+	for f in frames:
+		if int(f[0]) >= STALL_MS: stalls += 1
+	_cover_note("title", 0, stalls, worst / 1000)   # the title has no cover: its menu stays drawn, so only stalls count
+	_shift_process(frames)
+	frames.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x[0] > y[0])
+	_say("[load1434] title worst frames split: %s" % "; ".join(_split(frames.slice(0, 5))))
+	_say("[load1434] title: backdrop %s; longest build stretch %d ms; worst frame while it built %d ms; backdrop ready after %d ms; sfx bus %s before, %s" % [
+		"%d ships" % st["ships"] if not st.is_empty() else "never built", int(st.get("worst_stretch", 0)) / 1000,
+		worst / 1000, Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0, before, "never moved" if moved.is_empty() else "moved to %s" % [moved.slice(0, 3)]])
+	_say("[load1434] title start to board parts (us) %s" % str(begin_seen))
+	m.queue_free()
+	for i in 10:
+		await process_frame
+	finished.append("title")
+
+
+func _find_button(n: Node, text: String) -> Button:
+	if n == null:
+		return null
+	if n is Button and (n as Button).text.strip_edges().to_lower() == text.to_lower() and (n as Button).is_visible_in_tree():
+		return n
+	for c in n.get_children():
+		var r := _find_button(c, text)
+		if r != null:
+			return r
+	return null
+
+
+func _click(at: Vector2) -> void:
+	var mv := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
+	mv.position = at
+	mv.global_position = at
+	root.push_input(mv)
+	for down in [true, false]:
+		var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
+		e.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
+		e.pressed = down
+		e.position = at
+		e.global_position = at
+		root.push_input(e)
+
+
+# leave: a fresh title, then its New run button clicked by a real mouse press and release while the backdrop is still
+# building, with a hull load or a kit hull instance still running (Artoo on PR 1445). Up to LEAVE_TRIES titles are tried
+# until one is caught with that work pending. Graded on that attempt only: the exit record must be that same backdrop
+# (its instance id), it must have left work pending, and its _exit_tree on the main thread must be under 100 ms. If no
+# attempt catches work pending, the case is INCONCLUSIVE and the run does not pass. Reported for the same attempt: click
+# to the first painted frame with the campaign in the tree, and the worst frame over the next 2 s.
+const LEAVE_TRIES := 4
+
+
+func _pending(sc) -> bool:
+	return not sc._inst_tasks.is_empty() or sc._preload.values().has(null)
+
+
+func _leave() -> void:
+	var BS = load("res://scenes/battle/battle.gd")
+	var SVs = load("res://render/ship_view.gd")
+	var graded := false
+	for attempt in range(1, LEAVE_TRIES + 1):
+		var m = MainScript.new()
+		root.add_child(m)
+		var w0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+		var caught := false
+		var sc = null
+		while Time.get_ticks_msec() - w0 < 120000:
+			await process_frame
+			sc = m.showcase
+			if sc == null or not is_instance_valid(sc) or sc.api == null:
+				continue
+			if not sc.load_stats.is_empty() or sc.showcase_ready:
+				break
+			if _pending(sc):
+				caught = true
+				break
+		if not caught or sc == null or not is_instance_valid(sc):
+			_say("[load1434] leave try %d: the backdrop finished before any work could be caught pending; trying a fresh title" % attempt)
+			m.queue_free()
+			for i in 10:
+				await process_frame
+			continue
+		var sc_id: int = sc.get_instance_id()
+		var what := "a kit instance" if not sc._inst_tasks.is_empty() else "a hull load"   # read now: the backdrop is freed after the click
+		var btn := _find_button(m, "New run")
+		var how := "New run button"
+		if btn == null:
+			btn = _find_button(m, "Continue run")
+			how = "Continue run button"
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		if btn != null:
+			_click(btn.get_global_rect().get_center())
+		else:
+			how = "main.new_run (no button found)"
+			m.new_run()
+		# the first painted frame with the campaign in the tree
+		var first_ms := -1
+		var f0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		while Time.get_ticks_usec() - f0 < 20000000:
+			await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+			if m.campaign != null and is_instance_valid(m.campaign) and m.campaign.is_inside_tree():
+				first_ms = (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000
+				break
+		var worst := 0
+		var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		var e0 := last
+		while Time.get_ticks_usec() - e0 < 2000000:
+			await process_frame
+			var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+			worst = maxi(worst, now - last)
+			last = now
+		var same: bool = int(BS.last_exit_id) == sc_id
+		var mid: bool = same and bool(BS.last_exit_mid_build)
+		var exit_ms: int = int(BS.last_exit_us) / 1000
+		var shown := "the backdrop's own exit %s" % ("%d ms on the main thread (limit 100)" % exit_ms if same else "never recorded (the last exit was another battle)")
+		_say("[load1434] leave try %d: %s clicked with %s pending; %s; it left work %s; click to first campaign frame %s; worst frame over the next 2 s %d ms; work handed on %d" % [
+			attempt, how, what, shown,
+			"pending (handed on)" if mid else "finished (not a valid test)",
+			("%d ms" % first_ms) if first_ms >= 0 else "never (20 s)", worst / 1000, SVs.retired_build_count()])
+		if m.campaign != null and is_instance_valid(m.campaign):
+			m.campaign.queue_free()
+		m.queue_free()
+		for i in 30:
+			await process_frame
+		if mid:
+			var ok: bool = exit_ms < 100 and first_ms >= 0
+			pass_all = pass_all and ok
+			_say("[load1434] leave %s (try %d: exit %d ms, click to first campaign frame %s)" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", attempt, exit_ms,
+				("%d ms" % first_ms) if first_ms >= 0 else "never"])
+			graded = true
+			break
+	if not graded:
+		pass_all = false
+		_say("[load1434] leave INCONCLUSIVE: no try in %d caught the backdrop with a load or kit instance pending, so the hand-off is unproven" % LEAVE_TRIES)
+	finished.append("leave")
+
+
+# b2r (reported, not graded): Battle 2 again in the same process, with its world bakes forced to run again (a fresh
+# bake folder and an empty memory cache) while every shader and pipeline it uses is already warm. LOAD6 showed 5 to 10 s
+# main-thread frames with bakes pending; if they come back here the bakes cause them, if not the first-use shader work does.
+func _b2_again() -> void:
+	var Baker = load("res://world/world_bake.gd")
+	var fresh := OS.get_user_data_dir().path_join("load1434_b2r_bakes_%d" % OS.get_process_id())
+	OS.set_environment("VS_WORLD_CACHE", fresh)
+	Baker._cache.clear()
+	Baker._textures.clear()
+	var keep := pass_all
+	var keep_cover := cover_ok_all
+	await _battle("b2r", {"seed": 202})
+	cover_ok_all = keep_cover
+	_say("[load1434] b2r is reported only (bakes again, shaders warm): its FAIL or PASS above does not count toward RESULT")
+	pass_all = keep
+	cover_notes[-1] = "b2r reported only"
+	# the folder stays: bakes still running would write into it; it lives in this run's own throwaway Godot profile
+
+
+# the bakes made during loads write their PNGs once nothing loads: wait for them, so the next (warm) launch on this
+# profile finds them on disk; run before b2r too, so its folder switch cannot meet a pending normal write
+func _drain(label: String) -> void:
+	var svc = root.get_node_or_null("WorldBakes")
+	var sw0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var sworst := 0
+	var slast := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	while svc != null and (not svc._unsaved.is_empty() or svc._active != "" or not svc._queue.is_empty()) and Time.get_ticks_msec() - sw0 < 180000:
+		await process_frame
+		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		sworst = maxi(sworst, now - slast)
+		slast = now
+	# Artoo on PR 1445: count the writes that saved, not an empty queue
+	_say("[load1434] world bake writes %s: %s in %d ms, worst frame meanwhile %d ms (reported only)" % [
+		label, "no bake service" if svc == null else "%d written, %d failed, %d still queued%s" % [svc.written, svc.write_failed, svc._unsaved.size(),
+			", one still being written" if svc._active == svc.SAVE_JOB else ""], Time.get_ticks_msec() - sw0, sworst / 1000])
+
+
+# issue 1434 (LOAD19: the warm profile still paid 5 s for 83 pipelines): the shader codes this launch made through
+# render/shader_keep.gd, against the ones the last launch on this profile made. A code new on the warm launch changes
+# from launch to launch, so its shader and pipelines never come from the disk caches.
+const CODES_FILE := "user://load1434_codes_seen.txt"
+
+
+func _codes_since_last_launch() -> void:
+	var before := {}
+	if FileAccess.file_exists(CODES_FILE):
+		for line in FileAccess.get_file_as_string(CODES_FILE).split("\n", false):
+			before[line.get_slice(" ", 0)] = true
+	var fresh := PackedStringArray()
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for h in SKEEP.seen:
+		out.append("%s %s" % [h, SKEEP.seen[h]])
+		if not before.is_empty() and not before.has(h):
+			fresh.append("%s %s" % [SKEEP.seen[h], h])
+	var f := FileAccess.open(CODES_FILE, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f != null:
+		f.store_string("\n".join(out) + "\n")
+		f.close()
+	if before.is_empty():
+		_say("[load1434] shader codes: %d made this launch; no earlier launch on this profile to compare (reported only)" % SKEEP.seen.size())
+	else:
+		_say("[load1434] shader codes: %d made this launch, %d not made by the last launch on this profile%s (reported only)" % [
+			SKEEP.seen.size(), fresh.size(), (": " + ", ".join(fresh.slice(0, 20))) if not fresh.is_empty() else ""])
+
+
+# the disk caches this launch starts with (issue 1434 LOAD19: does the warm launch find the pipeline cache)
+func _caches_at_start() -> String:
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for sub in ["vulkan", "shader_cache"]:
+		var n := 0
+		var bytes := 0
+		var stack: Array = [OS.get_user_data_dir().path_join(sub)]
+		while not stack.is_empty():
+			var d: String = stack.pop_back()
+			var da := DirAccess.open(d)
+			if da == null:
+				continue
+			for f in da.get_files():
+				n += 1
+				var fa := FileAccess.open(d.path_join(f), FileAccess.READ)
+				if fa != null:
+					bytes += fa.get_length()
+					fa.close()
+			for sd in da.get_directories():
+				stack.append(d.path_join(sd))
+		out.append("%s %d files %.1f MB" % [sub, n, bytes / 1048576.0])
+	out.append("pipeline cache setting %s" % str(ProjectSettings.get_setting("rendering/rendering_device/pipeline_cache/enable", "unset")))
+	return ", ".join(out)
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	_say("[load1434] display %s, window %s, renderer %s" % [DisplayServer.get_name(), str(root.get_visible_rect().size), RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method()])
+	_say("[load1434] caches at start: " + _caches_at_start())
+	if "s25" in cases: await _battle("s25", {"scenario": "s25"})
+	if "title" in cases: await _title()
+	if "leave" in cases: await _leave()
+	if "b1" in cases: await _battle("b1", {"seed": 101})
+	if "b2" in cases: await _battle("b2", {"seed": 202})
+	if "b3" in cases: await _battle("b3", {"seed": 303})
+	if "b2r" in cases:
+		await _drain("before b2r")
+		await _b2_again()
+	if "s25r" in cases:
+		var keep := pass_all
+		var keep_cover := cover_ok_all
+		await _battle("s25r", {"scenario": "s25"})
+		cover_ok_all = keep_cover
+		pass_all = keep
+		cover_notes[-1] = "s25r reported only"
+		_say("[load1434] s25r is reported only (the 24-ship battle again, every shader and pipeline already made this launch): its FAIL or PASS above does not count toward RESULT")
+	_codes_since_last_launch()
+	for c in cases:
+		if not c in finished:
+			pass_all = false
+			_say("[load1434] %s FAIL: the case stopped before its end (see the script error above)" % c)
+	await _drain("after the loads")
+	_say("[load1434] COVER %s on the %s profile (the loading cover up on every frame to play and no frame of %d s or more: %s)" % [
+		"PASS" if cover_ok_all else "FAIL", pass_name, STALL_MS / 1000, ", ".join(cover_notes)])
+	_say("[load1434] RESULT %s on the %s profile (limit %d ms for each graded item: slice, ready, cover frame, title click, title frame, bus; leave exit limit 100 ms; graded on the warm profile, the cold one reported with its COVER line, Board Nov 21)" % ["PASS" if pass_all else "FAIL", pass_name, LIMIT_MS])
+	if out_dir != "":
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(out_dir)
+		var f := FileAccess.open(out_dir.path_join("load_result.txt"), FileAccess.WRITE)
+		if f != null:
+			f.store_string("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+			f.close()
+	quit(0 if pass_all else 1)

+extends SceneTree
+# Issue 1518 (Artoo on PR 1445, 6784b6b1): writes a valid, resumable campaign run into this launch's user:// so the PC
+# harness (contrib/opus/pc/1434/load1434_runs.ps1) can launch the title cold with a saved run (its first button
+# "Continue run"). The same steps as main/test/title_continue_test.gd. It refuses unless user:// sits inside a

+const Campaign := preload("res://campaign/campaign.gd")
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	_run.call_deferred()

+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var ud := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://").replace("\\", "/")

+	c.fixed_clock = true
+	preload("res://rules/jsm.gd").rnd_seed(1124)
+	c.titleScreen()
+	c.act("newRunScreen")
+	c.act("startRun")
+	if c.modal_d != null and c.modal_d.get("kind") == "aspect":
+		c.act("pickAspect", c.W["aspOffer"][0])
+	c.act("saveQuit")
+	var ok: bool = Campaign.has_saved_run(c.save_path)
+	print("[save1434] %s: a resumable run %s at %s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "saved" if ok else "was not saved", ProjectSettings.globalize_path(c.save_path)])
+	quit(0 if ok else 1)

+

--- /dev/null
+++ b/godot/render/shader_keep.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+extends RefCounted
+# Issue 1434 (LOAD14: each new Shader resource compiled again on the main thread when a battle, the title backdrop or a
+# squadron built its materials: the board's grid shaders 0.2 to 0.3 s, a Navy fighter wing 0.7 s, the effects shaders
+# 0.6 s at every title). One Shader per source code for the whole session, so the second battle reuses the first one's
+# compiled shader. Materials stay per object (their uniforms are their own); only the shared code is kept.
+# GPU-holding static: render/static_caches.gd clears it before the engine exits.
+
+static var _keep := {}   # shader code -> Shader
+# issue 1434 (LOAD17: a 796 ms title draw with 0 pipelines, so shader source work, not pipelines): the load bench turns
+# watch on and reads made each frame, so a long draw names the new shaders the frame before it made (not GPU: text)
+static var watch := false
+static var made: Array = []
+static var seen := {}   # issue 1434 (LOAD19): every code hash made this launch -> where, for the bench's launch-to-launch check
+
+
+static func of(code: String) -> Shader:
+	var s: Shader = _keep.get(code)
+	if s == null:
+		s = Shader.new()
+		s.code = code
+		_keep[code] = s
+		_note(code)
+	return s
+
+
+# a Shader built elsewhere (fx_hull.gd shared_shader) kept for the session too
+static func keep(code: String, s: Shader) -> void:
+	if not _keep.has(code):
+		_note(code)
+	_keep[code] = s
+
+
+static func _note(code: String) -> void:
+	if not watch:
+		return
+	var at := "?"
+	for fr in get_stack().slice(2, 4):
+		at = "%s:%d" % [str(fr["source"]).get_file(), int(fr["line"])]
+		if not at.begins_with("fx_hull.gd"):
+			break
+	var h := "%08x" % (code.hash() & 0xffffffff)
+	made.append("%s %s" % [at, h])
+	seen[h] = at
+
+
+static func take_made() -> String:
+	if made.is_empty():
+		return "-"
+	var n := made.size()
+	var said := ", ".join(PackedStringArray(made.slice(0, 6))) + (" and %d more" % (n - 6) if n > 6 else "")
+	made.clear()
+	return "%d: %s" % [n, said]
+
+
+static func has(code: String) -> bool:
+	return _keep.has(code)
+
+
+static func get_kept(code: String) -> Shader:
+	return _keep.get(code)
+
+
+static func clear_static() -> void:
+	_keep.clear()
+	made.clear()
+	seen.clear()

+# on the main thread for its hull loads and worker instances still running. It hands them here: each frame the finished

+extends SceneTree
+# Issue 1434 (Artoo on PR 1445, head 31bb5117): the sliced board's terrain file loads are collected once or handed on.
+# A board that leaves the tree during its terrain wait (a close or a leave) never waits on a load still running: the
+# request goes to ShipView.retire_build, which collects it over the next frames. A finished one is collected at once.
+# Headless; uses a real project resource as the stand-in terrain file.
+
+const Board := preload("res://render/board.gd")
+const SV := preload("res://render/ship_view.gd")
+
+var fails := 0
+
+
+func _check(ok: bool, what: String) -> void:
+	print(("PASS  " if ok else "FAIL  ") + what)
+	if not ok:
+		fails += 1
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	_run.call_deferred()
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var path := "res://render/test/fixtures/board_terrain_stub.tres"
+	# 1. leaving the tree mid-wait: the board's requests are all handed on or collected, none left with the board
+	var b = Board.new()
+	root.add_child(b)
+	_check(ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path) == OK, "the stand-in terrain file starts a threaded load")
+	b._terrain_loads.append(path)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	root.remove_child(b)   # _exit_tree: collect or hand on, without waiting
+	var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+	_check(b._terrain_loads.is_empty(), "the board keeps no request after leaving the tree")
+	_check(ms < 100.0, "leaving the tree took %.1f ms (limit 100)" % ms)
+	var handed: bool = SV._retired_loads.has(path)
+	var done := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS
+	_check(handed or done, "a load still running was handed to ShipView.retire_build (handed %s)" % handed)
+	b.free()
+	var f0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while SV._retired_loads.has(path) and Time.get_ticks_msec() - f0 < 5000:
+		await process_frame
+	_check(not SV._retired_loads.has(path), "the handed load is collected within 5 s")
+	# 2. a finished load is collected at once (wait true)
+	var b2 = Board.new()
+	root.add_child(b2)
+	ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
+	b2._terrain_loads.append(path)
+	b2._drop_terrain_loads(true)
+	_check(b2._terrain_loads.is_empty() and not SV._retired_loads.has(path), "a wait drop collects its own load")
+	b2.queue_free()
+	await process_frame
+	print("board_terrain_load_check: %s" % ("PASS" if fails == 0 else "FAIL (%d)" % fails))
+	quit(1 if fails else 0)

# every quit goes through here: free what statics hold first, then quit (see ShipView.clear_static).
# Issue 1435 (W3): the window close button and Alt-F4 come here too (auto accept is off, see _notification), and it runs
# once however many ask: no new showcase or load work starts, the scenes are freed, the fx jobs drain once
# (static_caches clear_all, fx.gd clear_static) and the statics are cleared before the process ends.
var quitting := false
var quit_route := ""   # what started the quit ("menu" or "window"), for logs and the quit route check


# issue 1434 (LOAD13 cold title_load_5s: the window hid 5.2 s after the close): the last frames before a close, each
# with what was loading, so a close that waited on one long frame names it. A few numbers a frame, kept for 8 frames.
var _frame_t := 0
var _frames: Array = []
# issue 1434 (LOAD17 cold title_load_5s: one 5.35 s frame, cause not split): the renderer's draw time since the last
# _process (frame_pre_draw to frame_post_draw), and the world bakes handed back meanwhile, kept with each frame
var _draw_pre := 0
var _draw_acc := 0


func _on_frame_pre_draw() -> void:
	_draw_pre = Time.get_ticks_usec()


func _on_frame_post_draw() -> void:
	if _draw_pre > 0:
		_draw_acc += Time.get_ticks_usec() - _draw_pre
	_draw_pre = 0


func _frame_parts() -> String:
	var parts := "draw %d ms" % (_draw_acc / 1000)
	_draw_acc = 0
	var back: String = WORLD_BAKE.take_handed_back()
	return parts + (", bake handed back " + back if back != "" else "")


func _process(_dt: float) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	if _frame_t > 0:
		var parts := _frame_parts()
		var what := ""
		if battle != null and is_instance_valid(battle) and battle.get("warming") == true:
			what += "battle " + str(battle.get("load_phase"))
		elif showcase != null and is_instance_valid(showcase) and showcase.get("showcase_ready") == false:
			what += "backdrop " + str(showcase.get("load_phase"))
			var w = showcase.get("world")
			if w != null and is_instance_valid(w) and str(w.get("load_step")) != "":
				what += ", world " + str(w.get("load_step"))
		_frames.append("%d ms (%s; %s)" % [(now - _frame_t) / 1000, what if what != "" else "-", parts])
		if _frames.size() > 8:
			_frames.pop_front()
	_frame_t = now


func quit_clean(code := 0, route := "menu") -> void:
	if quitting:
		return
	quitting = true
	quit_route = route
	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	print("[main] quit (%s) at %d ms" % [route, t0])
	if _frame_t > 0:
		_frames.append("%d ms so far (this frame; %s)" % [(Time.get_ticks_usec() - _frame_t) / 1000, _frame_parts()])
	print("[main] frames before the close, oldest first: %s" % ", ".join(_frames))
	# issue 1518 (Artoo on PR 1445): what was loading when the close came, so a close timed "during a load" is proven
	var loading := PackedStringArray()
	if battle != null and is_instance_valid(battle) and battle.get("warming") == true:
		loading.append("battle %s" % str(battle.get("load_phase")))
	if showcase != null and is_instance_valid(showcase) and showcase.get("showcase_ready") == false:
		loading.append("backdrop %s" % str(showcase.get("load_phase")))
	var svc := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null("WorldBakes")
	# a world bake still to run belongs to a load; the deferred PNG write ("#save") runs once loads are over, so it is not
	if svc != null and ((str(svc.get("_active")) != "" and str(svc.get("_active")) != "#save") or not (svc.get("_queue") as Array).is_empty()):
		loading.append("world bake %s" % str(svc.get("_active")).left(12))
	print("[main] loading at the close: %s" % (", ".join(loading) if not loading.is_empty() else "nothing"))
	# Issue 1435: the player asked to close, so the window goes at once; the clean-up below still runs to the end
	if route == "window" and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_MINIMIZED)
	for n in [battle, showcase]:
		if n != null and is_instance_valid(n):
			if n.has_method("stop_build"):
				n.stop_build()   # issue 1518: a load under way stops at its next step and starts no more work
			if "quitting" in n:
				n.quitting = true   # issue 521: an awaiting command must not draw on the freed HUD
			n.queue_free()
	if campaign != null and is_instance_valid(campaign):
		campaign.queue_free()
	if _retired != null and is_instance_valid(_retired) and _retired.get_parent() == null:
		_retired.free()   # issue 1519: a battle left for the title and not yet freed goes before the statics are cleared
	if music != null and is_instance_valid(music) and music.has_method("release"):
		music.release()
	if ResourceLoader.has_cached(BATTLE_SCRIPT):
		load(BATTLE_SCRIPT).drop_sky_pending()   # a battle script never read has no sky read to drop
	if _scene_reading and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(BATTLE_SCENE) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(BATTLE_SCENE)
		_scene_reading = false
	if _fx_reading and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(FX_SCRIPT) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(FX_SCRIPT)
		_fx_reading = false
	if _host_reading and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(HOST_SCRIPT) != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
		ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(HOST_SCRIPT)
		_host_reading = false
	Sfx.drop_pending()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	var t1 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	# issue 1204: every script with a GPU-holding static is on one list (render/static_caches.gd)
	load("res://render/static_caches.gd").clear_all()
	var t2 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	print("[main] quit stages: scenes freed + 2 frames %d ms, statics and fx drain %d ms, engine exit from %d ms" % [t1 - t0, t2 - t1, t2])
	get_tree().quit(code)


# Issue 1435 (W3): the system close (title bar X, Alt-F4) used to end the process straight from SceneTree, past
# quit_clean, so the statics were released after the rendering server (the crash class static_caches.gd describes).
func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST:
		quit_clean(0, "window")


# bot runs: count every engine and script error per run (Godot 4.5+ Logger), since a script error never reaches the run's
# own result
class ErrCount extends Logger:
	var n := 0
	var first: Array = []
	var mutex := Mutex.new()

	func _log_error(function: String, file: String, line: int, code: String, rationale: String, editor_notify: bool, error_type: int, script_backtraces: Array) -> void:
		if error_type == Logger.ERROR_TYPE_WARNING:
			return
		mutex.lock()
		n += 1
		if first.size() < 5:
			first.append("%s (%s:%d) %s" % [rationale if rationale != "" else code, file.get_file(), line, function])
		mutex.unlock()

	func _log_message(message: String, error: bool) -> void:
		pass

	func take() -> Array:
		mutex.lock()
		var out := [n, first.duplicate()]
		n = 0
		first.clear()
		mutex.unlock()
		return out

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Main"
	get_tree().set_auto_accept_quit(false)   # issue 1435: the window close runs quit_clean (see _notification)
	RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw.connect(_on_frame_pre_draw)   # issue 1434: the close's frame log splits the draw
	RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(_on_frame_post_draw)
	_args()
	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		print("[main] ready at %d ms after the engine started" % Time.get_ticks_msec())   # issue 1518 (LOAD29): the launch's own share
		# issue 1518: the sound clips and the battle scene start loading on worker threads now, so the frame that builds the
		# first battle only collects them
		Sfx.prefetch()
		if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(BATTLE_SCENE) == OK:
			_scene_reading = true   # the sky read starts once the battle script is read (battle_parts_ready)
		if not ResourceLoader.has_cached(HOST_SCRIPT) and ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(HOST_SCRIPT) == OK:
			_host_reading = true   # read on a worker; a load() of it meanwhile waits only for what is not read yet
		if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(FX_SCRIPT) == OK:
			_fx_reading = true
	if args.has("player-path"):
		var recorder = load("res://main/player_path.gd")
		var profile_error: String = recorder.prepare_profile()
		if profile_error != "":
			printerr("[player-path] FAIL ", profile_error)
			get_tree().quit(1)
			return
		player_path = recorder.new()
		add_child(player_path)
	if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		DisplayServer.window_set_title(load("res://ui/battle/brand.gd").TITLE)  # brand.gd: the one place to rename the game
	bot_mode = player_path == null and args.has("bot-runs")
	# a fresh profile starts on Standard enemy AI (onboarding fix 1, campaign3d.js:3); bot runs ignore the player's
	# settings file and play Veteran, as sim3d does, unless --ai says otherwise
	if bot_mode:
		settings["ai"] = str(args.get("ai", "veteran"))
	else:
		_load_settings()
	_apply_settings()
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://music/music_player.gd") and not args.has("bot-runs"):
		music = load("res://music/music_player.gd").new()
		music.name = "Music"
		add_child(music)
		music.set_volume(float(settings.get("music_volume", 0.7)))
		music.set_on(bool(settings.get("music", true)))
	if not args.has("bot-runs") and ResourceLoader.exists("res://audio/sfx.gd"):
		ui_sound = load("res://audio/sfx.gd").new()
		ui_sound.only = "ui_"
		ui_sound.name = "UiSound"
		add_child(ui_sound)
		OrdersKit.sound = ui_sound
		_settings_to_ui_sound()
	if args.has("quit-after"):
		# a hard stop for test jobs, on every screen (real time, whatever the clock speed)
		var lim := float(args["quit-after"])
		get_tree().create_timer(lim, true, false, true).timeout.connect(func() -> void:
			print("[main] quit-after %d s reached, quitting" % int(lim))
			quit_clean(3))
	if player_path != null:
		player_path.start.call_deferred(self)
	elif args.has("check-export"):
		_check_export.call_deferred()
	elif bot_mode:
		_bot_runs.call_deferred()
